pitch_body:
Hi Jenny,

Your June update to 'Top Crypto Marketing Agencies in 2026' makes the case that a fractional marketer often beats an agency for crypto teams, but it doesn't show what that looks like in practice. I can offer a concrete example for the next update.

I'm Shilika Jain, a fractional senior PR consultant for Web3, AI and cybersecurity startups, India-based and working globally. I led RARI Chain's mainnet launch (11 tier-1 placements in 24 hours, including The Block and Cointelegraph), MANTRA Chain's funding announcement as a CoinDesk exclusive, and Gaia AI's Forbes feature. Each case study lists its sources at shilikajain.com/work.

I could write a short sidebar on the three situations where a fractional PR lead wins (a fixed launch window, a founder-voice program, APAC localisation) and the two where an agency is still the better call. No fee, and you're free to edit or cut it.

Thanks,

Shilika Jain
Fractional PR for Web3, AI and cybersecurity startups
https://www.shilikajain.com | hi@shilikajain.com
